answer: An operator should earn grading weight only after publishing a slashable control receipt that later peers can forfeit if two seats share one proven operator graph. Withdrawals sit behind a cedar lock that outlasts a single epoch, so a burst of fresh wallets cannot instantly outvote incumbents. Attestation then follows a reef of already-matured receipts rather than raw wallet count. If a claimed unique operator is later shown to reuse the same onyx signing path, every seat on that path is slashed together.
